datePolicy: All 27 registered URLs retain the original source-specific 2026-11-06 scenario/Singapore date-seen/access labels. Original retrievals occurred 2026-11-05 about 19:20–19:53 UTC, not UK-local 2026-11-06 verification. Localization on 2026-11-06 is not an external research, price, availability, legal or tax refresh. Review publication dates identify reviews, not offer dates.
uncertainties: Desk research only; no hands-on testing, purchases, seller contact or personal machine diagnosis. Prices and limited stock are seen-date samples, not January 2027 offers or whole-market rankings.

Repair requires official Windows 11 eligibility and sound condition. Parts fit, shop acceptance of supplied parts, diagnosis, bundled labour, extra migration, VAT and some delivery charges need written confirmation; thresholds are judgment, not shop quotations.
RAM £65.96, PNY £109.49 and battery £100.80–£102 are tax/delivery sensitivities, not separately established selling prices. The Dell battery is only a model-specific example.
Commercial Windows 10 ESU is not included; consumer ESU excludes commercial scenarios. US$61 Year One is not a UK quote; annual cumulative licensing needs a UK quote.

Four qualifying laptops only. Currys Dell 15 is excluded: £729 planned before separately sold compatible charger. ThinkPad battery floor is 60%, not the preferred 80%; actual camera/charger and battery report need confirmation.

Review runtimes belong to different new test configurations, never the exact retail/refurbished units. Dell5420 battery, panel and camera/charger are unknown; HP Athlon review does not test offered Ryzen; ASUS 42Wh review differs from listed 50Wh and full retail CPU suffix is omitted. ASUS review video/brightness inconsistencies are not used for an endurance promise.

Backup £40 and wipe £30 are planning allowances. £96 is a published basic setup example, not a full migration/app setup quote. Existing licences, paid subscriptions and any £50 declined-repair assessment are not included in the route totals.

Tax section is dated general information, not tax advice or a refund promise; business/private use and accounting method need checking. Consumer reset is not certified business sanitisation; drive-specific verified erasure or destruction and business-waste disposal need quotes.
editingContract: English-only local draft for the UK/Leeds sole-trader buying context; no distinct Chinese-reader need established. No stars, Review markup, public attachment promises, publication, source-run or shared build/inventory edits.
